cohort: The study included 2,584,206 birthing individuals identified from birth and fetal death certificate data linked to hospital discharge records.
finding: Black individuals consistently experienced the highest rates of non-transfusion and total SMM across antepartum, intrapartum, and postpartum periods, with disparities being significantly higher and underreported when antepartum and postpartum SMM are included beyond just intrapartum SMM.
